fullText.simplified:
第十七章、引都陷落

    在南方的流放之路上，痛苦一直跟着我。
    我放不下一天天走向危险的楚国，放不下辛苦一生却看不到希望的楚国百姓。
    我是个诗人，在最难过的时候，我又开始写诗了。
    离开引都后，我在南方过了十八年，这是我人生最后的十八年。这段时间我写了很多诗歌，每一首都是我心里最深处的声音。人们记下了我的诗歌。在我死后的两千多年里，这些诗歌一直没有被人忘记，后人把它们放进了一本叫《楚辞》的诗歌集里。
    还记得《楚辞》吗？我在故事开头说过，《楚辞》和另一本叫《诗经》的书，都是中国非常古老的诗歌集。这两本诗歌集是中国文学的两大源头。
    引都再也没有人来。新王流放我的时候，就没想过再让我回去。后面几年，来自引都的消息，我都是从百姓那儿听到的。
    公元前284年，我到南方的第十二年，秦国和另外四个小国一起进攻齐国，齐国大败。
    公元前280年，我到南方的第十六年，秦国和楚国大战。楚国败了，北方有重要的土地被秦国抢走。第二年，秦国再次进攻楚国，楚国又败了，失去更多土地。
    公元前278年，我到南方的第十八年，秦国的大将军白起带军攻打楚国。白起是谁？是七国里最厉害的将军，他经历过无数场战争，从来没有败过。白起带着60万大军，攻破了楚国的大门，他们一直打到了引都。引都王宫里的王和官员、贵族们，在秦军到来之前，一起跑了。
    引都，楚国的首都，被秦国攻破了。楚国的王和官员们跑了。
fullText.traditional:
第十七章、引都陷落

    在南方的流放之路上，痛苦一直跟著我。
    我放不下一天天走向危險的楚國，放不下辛苦一生卻看不到希望的楚國百姓。
    我是個詩人，在最難過的時候，我又開始寫詩了。
    離開引都後，我在南方過了十八年，這是我人生最後的十八年。這段時間我寫了很多詩歌，每一首都是我心裡最深處的聲音。人們記下了我的詩歌。在我死後的兩千多年裡，這些詩歌一直沒有被人忘記，後人把它們放進了一本叫《楚辭》的詩歌集裡。
    還記得《楚辭》嗎？我在故事開頭說過，《楚辭》和另一本叫《詩經》的書，都是中國非常古老的詩歌集。這兩本詩歌集是中國文學的兩大源頭。
    引都再也沒有人來。新王流放我的時候，就沒想過再讓我回去。後面幾年，來自引都的消息，我都是從百姓那兒聽到的。
    公元前284年，我到南方的第十二年，秦國和另外四個小國一起進攻齊國，齊國大敗。
    公元前280年，我到南方的第十六年，秦國和楚國大戰。楚國敗了，北方有重要的土地被秦國搶走。第二年，秦國再次進攻楚國，楚國又敗了，失去更多土地。
    公元前278年，我到南方的第十八年，秦國的大將軍白起帶軍攻打楚國。白起是誰？是七國裡最厲害的將軍，他經歷過無數場戰爭，從來沒有敗過。白起帶著60萬大軍，攻破了楚國的大門，他們一直打到了引都。引都王宮裡的王和官員、貴族們，在秦軍到來之前，一起跑了。
    引都，楚國的首都，被秦國攻破了。楚國的王和官員們跑了。

sentences.simplified: 在南方的流放之路上，痛苦一直跟着我。
sentences.traditional: 在南方的流放之路上，痛苦一直跟著我。
sentences.pinyin: zài nán fāng de liú fàng zhī lù shang tòng kǔ yì zhí gēn zhe wǒ
sentences.english: On the road of exile in the south, pain followed me all the way.

sentences.simplified: 我放不下一天天走向危险的楚国，
sentences.traditional: 我放不下一天天走向危險的楚國，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ fàng bú xià yì tiān tiān zǒu xiàng wēi xiǎn de chǔ guó
sentences.english: I couldn’t let go of the state of Chu, which was heading into danger day by day, ..

sentences.simplified: 放不下辛苦一生却看不到希望的楚国百姓。
sentences.traditional: 放不下辛苦一生卻看不到希望的楚國百姓。
sentences.pinyin: fàng bú xià xīn kǔ yì shēng què kàn bú dào xī wàng de chǔ guó bǎi xìng
sentences.english: .. nor could I let go of the people of Chu who toiled all their lives yet saw no hope.

sentences.simplified: 我是个诗人，在最难过的时候，我又开始写诗了。
sentences.traditional: 我是個詩人，在最難過的時候，我又開始寫詩了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shì ge shī rén zài zuì nán guò de shí hou wǒ yòu kāi shǐ xiě shī le
sentences.english: I was a poet, and in my saddest moments, I began to write poetry again.

sentences.simplified: 离开引都后，我在南方过了十八年，这是我人生最后的十八年。
sentences.traditional: 離開引都後，我在南方過了十八年，這是我人生最後的十八年。
sentences.pinyin: lí kāi yǐn dū hòu wǒ zài nán fāng guò le shí bā nián zhè shì wǒ rén shēng zuì hòu de shí bā nián
sentences.english: After leaving Yindu, I spent eighteen years in the south. These were the final eighteen years of my life.

sentences.simplified: 这段时间我写了很多诗歌，每一首都是我心里最深处的声音。人们记下了我的诗歌。
sentences.traditional: 這段時間我寫了很多詩歌，每一首都是我心裡最深處的聲音。人們記下了我的詩歌。
sentences.pinyin: zhè duàn shí jiān wǒ xiě le hěn duō shī gē měi yì shǒu dōu shì wǒ xīn lǐ zuì shēn chù de shēng yīn rén men jì xià le wǒ de shī gē
sentences.english: During this period, I wrote many poems, each one the voice from the deepest part of my heart. People recorded my poems.

sentences.simplified: 在我死后的两千多年里，这些诗歌一直没有被人忘记，
sentences.traditional: 在我死後的兩千多年裡，這些詩歌一直沒有被人忘記，
sentences.pinyin: zài wǒ sǐ hòu de liǎng qiān duō nián lǐ zhè xiē shī gē yì zhí méi yǒu bèi rén wàng jì
sentences.english: In the more than two thousand years since my death, these poems have never been forgotten.

sentences.simplified: 后人把它们放进了一本叫《楚辞》的诗歌集里。
sentences.traditional: 後人把它們放進了一本叫《楚辭》的詩歌集裡。
sentences.pinyin: hòu rén bǎ tā men fàng jìn le yì běn jiào chǔ cí de shī gē jí lǐ
sentences.english: Later generations compiled them into a poetry collection called the “Songs of Chu”.

sentences.simplified: 还记得《楚辞》吗？
sentences.traditional: 還記得《楚辭》嗎？
sentences.pinyin: hái jì de chǔ cí ma
sentences.english: Do you remember the “Songs of Chu”?

sentences.simplified: 我在故事开头说过，《楚辞》和另一本叫《诗经》的书，
sentences.traditional: 我在故事開頭說過，《楚辭》和另一本叫《詩經》的書，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài gù shi kāi tóu shuō guò chǔ cí hé lìng yì běn jiào shī jīng de shū
sentences.english: I mentioned at the beginning of the story that the “Songs of Chu” and another book called the “Book of Songs” ..

sentences.simplified: 都是中国非常古老的诗歌集。
sentences.traditional: 都是中國非常古老的詩歌集。
sentences.pinyin: dōu shì zhōng guó fēi cháng gǔ lǎo de shī gē jí
sentences.english: .. are both very ancient poetry collections in China.

sentences.simplified: 这两本诗歌集是中国文学的两大源头。
sentences.traditional: 這兩本詩歌集是中國文學的兩大源頭。
sentences.pinyin: zhè liǎng běn shī gē jí shì zhōng guó wén xué de liǎng dà yuán tóu
sentences.english: These two poetry collections are the two major fountainheads of Chinese literature.

sentences.simplified: 引都再也没有人来。新王流放我的时候，就没想过再让我回去。
sentences.traditional: 引都再也沒有人來。新王流放我的時候，就沒想過再讓我回去。
sentences.pinyin: yǐn dū zài yě méi yǒu rén lái xīn wáng liú fàng wǒ de shí hou jiù méi xiǎng guò zài ràng wǒ huí qù
sentences.english: No one ever came for me from Yindu again. When the new king banished me, he never intended to let me return.

sentences.simplified: 后面几年，来自引都的消息，我都是从百姓那儿听到的。
sentences.traditional: 後面幾年，來自引都的消息，我都是從百姓那兒聽到的。
sentences.pinyin: hòu miàn jǐ nián lái zì yǐn dū de xiāo xi wǒ dōu shì cóng bǎi xìng nà'r tīng dào de
sentences.english: In the following years, I heard news from Yindu only from the common people.

sentences.simplified: 公元前284年，我到南方的第十二年，秦国和另外四个小国一起进攻齐国，
sentences.traditional: 公元前284年，我到南方的第十二年，秦國和另外四個小國一起進攻齊國，
sentences.pinyin: gōng yuán qián 3 nián wǒ dào nán fāng de dì shí èr nián qín guó hé lìng wài sì ge xiǎo guó yì qǐ jìn gōng qí guó
sentences.english: In 284 BCE, the twelfth year after I arrived in the south, the state of Qin and the four other small states attacked the state of Qi.

sentences.simplified: 齐国大败。
sentences.traditional: 齊國大敗。
sentences.pinyin: qí guó dà bài
sentences.english: Qi suffered a great defeat.

sentences.simplified: 公元前280年，我到南方的第十六年，秦国和楚国大战。
sentences.traditional: 公元前280年，我到南方的第十六年，秦國和楚國大戰。
sentences.pinyin: gōng yuán qián 3 nián wǒ dào nán fāng de dì shí liù nián qín guó hé chǔ guó dà zhàn
sentences.english: In 280 BCE, the sixteenth year after I arrived in the south, the state of Qin and the state of Chu fought a great battle.

sentences.simplified: 楚国败了，北方有重要的土地被秦国抢走。
sentences.traditional: 楚國敗了，北方有重要的土地被秦國搶走。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ guó bài le běi fāng yǒu zhòng yào de tǔ dì bèi qín guó qiǎng zǒu
sentences.english: Chu was defeated, and Qin seized important land in the north.

sentences.simplified: 第二年，秦国再次进攻楚国，楚国又败了，失去更多土地。
sentences.traditional: 第二年，秦國再次進攻楚國，楚國又敗了，失去更多土地。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr nián qín guó zài cì jìn gōng chǔ guó chǔ guó yòu bài le shī qù gèng duō tǔ dì
sentences.english: The following year, Qin attacked Chu again. Chu was defeated once more, losing even more land.

sentences.simplified: 公元前278年，我到南方的第十八年，秦国的大将军白起带军攻打楚国。
sentences.traditional: 公元前278年，我到南方的第十八年，秦國的大將軍白起帶軍攻打楚國。
sentences.pinyin: gōng yuán qián 3 nián wǒ dào nán fāng de dì shí bā nián qín guó de dà jiāng jūn bái qǐ dài jūn gōng dǎ chǔ guó
sentences.english: In 278 BCE, the eighteenth year after I arrived in the south, the great general Bai Qi of Qin led an army to attack Chu.

sentences.simplified: 白起是谁？
sentences.traditional: 白起是誰？
sentences.pinyin: bái qǐ shì shéi
sentences.english: Who was Bai Qi?

sentences.simplified: 是七国里最厉害的将军，他经历过无数场战争，从来没有败过。
sentences.traditional: 是七國裡最厲害的將軍，他經歷過無數場戰爭，從來沒有敗過。
sentences.pinyin: shì qī guó lǐ zuì lì hai de jiāng jūn tā jīng lì guò wú shù cháng zhàn zhēng cóng lái méi yǒu bài guò
sentences.english: He was the most formidable general among the seven warring states. He had experienced countless wars without ever being defeated.

sentences.simplified: 白起带着60万大军，攻破了楚国的大门，他们一直打到了引都。
sentences.traditional: 白起帶著60萬大軍，攻破了楚國的大門，他們一直打到了引都。
sentences.pinyin: bái qǐ dài zhe 2 wàn dà jūn gōng pò le chǔ guó de dà mén tā men yì zhí dǎ dào le yǐn dū
sentences.english: Bai Qi led an army of 600,000, which broke through the gates of Chu and fought all the way to Yindu.

sentences.simplified: 引都王宫里的王和官员、贵族们，在秦军到来之前，一起跑了。
sentences.traditional: 引都王宮裡的王和官員、貴族們，在秦軍到來之前，一起跑了。
sentences.pinyin: yǐn dū wáng gōng lǐ de wáng hé guān yuán guì zú men zài qín jūn dào lái zhī qián yì qǐ pǎo le
sentences.english: The king, officials, and nobles in the palace of Yindu all fled together before the Qin army arrived.

sentences.simplified: 引都，楚国的首都，被秦国攻破了。楚国的王和官员们跑了。
sentences.traditional: 引都，楚國的首都，被秦國攻破了。楚國的王和官員們跑了。
sentences.pinyin: yǐn dū chǔ guó de shǒu dū bèi qín guó gōng pò le chǔ guó de wáng hé guān yuán men pǎo le
sentences.english: Yindu, the capital of Chu, was taken by Qin. The king and officials of Chu fled.

sentence_translations: Chapter 17: The Fall of Yindu
On the road of exile in the south, pain followed me all the way.
I couldn’t let go of the state of Chu, which was heading into danger day by day, ..
.. nor could I let go of the people of Chu who toiled all their lives yet saw no hope.
I was a poet, and in my saddest moments, I began to write poetry again.
After leaving Yindu, I spent eighteen years in the south. These were the final eighteen years of my life.
During this period, I wrote many poems, each one the voice from the deepest part of my heart. People recorded my poems.
In the more than two thousand years since my death, these poems have never been forgotten.
Later generations compiled them into a poetry collection called the “Songs of Chu”.
Do you remember the “Songs of Chu”?
I mentioned at the beginning of the story that the “Songs of Chu” and another book called the “Book of Songs” ..
.. are both very ancient poetry collections in China.
These two poetry collections are the two major fountainheads of Chinese literature.
No one ever came for me from Yindu again. When the new king banished me, he never intended to let me return.
In the following years, I heard news from Yindu only from the common people.
In 284 BCE, the twelfth year after I arrived in the south, the state of Qin and the four other small states attacked the state of Qi.
Qi suffered a great defeat.
In 280 BCE, the sixteenth year after I arrived in the south, the state of Qin and the state of Chu fought a great battle.
Chu was defeated, and Qin seized important land in the north.
The following year, Qin attacked Chu again. Chu was defeated once more, losing even more land.
In 278 BCE, the eighteenth year after I arrived in the south, the great general Bai Qi of Qin led an army to attack Chu.
Who was Bai Qi?
He was the most formidable general among the seven warring states. He had experienced countless wars without ever being defeated.
Bai Qi led an army of 600,000, which broke through the gates of Chu and fought all the way to Yindu.
The king, officials, and nobles in the palace of Yindu all fled together before the Qin army arrived.
Yindu, the capital of Chu, was taken by Qin. The king and officials of Chu fled.
